text:
maria: FYI vendor updated lead times for the April H100 allocation — 2-week slip on the main AWB and a partial RMA batch might ship earlier.
thomas: can you paste the AWB and which SKUs are partial? we need to decide on backfill vs expedite cost.
maria: AWB: 1Z999AA10123456789. Partial contains 6x H100-80GB units and 2x H200s, remaining 14x H100s held at EU port.
ashwin: If we expedite air for the 6 units what's the delta? last quote from nicolas was ~+$1.6k/unit air uplift.
maria: vendor message pasted below — nicolas confirmed in thread:

nicolas (vendor): "Confirming partial release. We can air-express the 6 units with consolidated RMA paperwork for €9,600 total uplift. Ground reconsign for rest delays 10–14 business days due to customs backlog. If Redwood wants full expedite we can prioritise but need a PO amendment."

emily: ops question — do we have reservoir spare pool to cover the 6 units for priority customers if we delay? current pool is 4 H100s in LHR.
thomas: No, pool won't cover. Options: 1) accept air uplift and route to LHR depot; 2) rotate lower-tier H200s for non-critical tenants; 3) throttle workloads and notify sales for impacted customers.
ashwin: Cost math quick: air uplift €9,600 / 6 => €1,600/unit. If we lease 2x temporary H100 for short term estimated €2,400/month each — longer runway but higher monthly ops.
maria: Ops-bot generated RMA ticket after vendor note:
ops-bot: "RMA created: RMA-98734 | Vendor: NexaSupply | AWB: 1Z999AA10123456789 | Partial: 6 H100, 2 H200 | Status: pending-customer-authorization"

maria: Also customs flagged HS code mismatch on 2 H200s — vendor says they'll reissue commercial invoice. That might hold the remaining units another 3–5 days.
thomas: Important: if we sign off on air uplift, need finance pre-approval for one-off expedite spend. @ashwin can you run a quick approval? attach GL and approver.
ashwin: I can pre-approve up to €15k from EMEA ops discretionary budget. Need email confirmation from vendor and revised invoice. cc finance.
emily: Depot workflow: if air lands, we need photo QA and serial reconciliation at receiving dock before crossdock. Please ensure vendor prepends manifest with batch serial list. Use template below for manifest acceptance:

```
RECEIVING CHECKLIST
- AWB: 1Z999AA10123456789
- Expected units: 6x H100-80GB
- Vendor manifest: attached
- Photos required: pallet, unit label, serial stickers (high-res)
- Depot acceptance within 2 hours of arrival
- Escalate to @thomas if serial mismatch >2 units
```

maria: vendor already agreed to include high-res photos and scanned serials.
nicolas (vendor): "Uploading manifest and photos by EOD UTC. Revised invoice for air uplift will be emailed to ashwin@redwood.com. We'll also correct HS codes for the H200s."

thomas: okay consensus: proceed with air-express for the 6 H100s. ashwin to approve invoice. emily to prep depot for fast-turn QA. maria to confirm PO amendment and notify impacted accounts.
ashwin: approved in principle — will sign once invoice lands. finance note: classify as one-off logistics uplift and tag to code INF-GPU-EXP.
maria: I'll open a brief customer-facing note for the top 3 impacted customers and CC sales ops; will add rollback plan if air is delayed.
emily: small ask — can vendor include a spare foam insert per unit? last air batch had 1 unit with transit foam damage.
nicolas (vendor): "We'll include reinforced foam inserts for the air pallet and add extra packing photos."
maria: great. closing tasks: RMA-98734 assigned -> ops, vendor invoice pending -> ashwin, depot prep -> emily, customer comms -> maria. Any objections? :thumbsup:
thomas: :thumbsup:
ashwin: :thumbsup:
emily: :thumbsup:
nicolas (vendor): Thanks, will stay on the thread and update AWB tracking.
ops-bot: "RMA-98734 status updated to approved-expedite by ashwin at 3664100300."
